declaration.preface:
At Arsh Fashions, we prioritize the rights and well-being of every employee, recognizing that their welfare is crucial to our success. Our Employee Rights and Well-Being Policy is designed to ensure a safe, equitable, and supportive work environment. We are committed to upholding fair labour practices, providing adequate compensation, and maintaining safe working conditions in alignment with global standards.

This policy outlines our dedication to respecting and protecting employee rights while fostering a culture of mutual respect and support. By promoting well-being and addressing concerns proactively, we aim to empower our team and drive positive, sustainable growth within our organization.
declaration.declaration: Arsh Fashions is committed to protecting employee rights and ensuring a safe, fair, and supportive work environment. We adhere to all labor laws and international standards, providing equitable compensation and addressing workplace safety. Our policy promotes respect, inclusivity, and continuous improvement for employee well-being. Our baseline year is 2023, for setting the reference framework for evaluating progress, compliance, and improvements in our employee rights and well-being practices.
declaration.scope: This Policy is applicable to following sites and all of its employees, workers, sub-contractors and other stakeholders:

focusAreas: Proactive safety awareness and continuous improvement

Proactive safety awareness and continuou: Foster a culture of proactive safety awareness and continuous improvement.
Compensation and benefits: Provide transparent communication about compensation and benefits policies.
Working conditions: Maintain a clean, ergonomic, and well-lit work environment and regularly engage employees in feedback about their working conditions.
Water conservation: Educate employees on water conservation techniques and the importance of reducing water usage in manufacturing.
Labor relations and grievance resolution: Build strong, transparent communication channels between management and staff and resolve conflicts and grievances efficiently and fairly.
Child and forced labor prevention: Educate suppliers and partners to implement strict policies and audits to prevent child and forced labor.
Inclusion and representation: Create an inclusive environment where all employees feel valued and respected and develop programs to promote understanding and address biases.
Human rights inquiries: Ensure transparency and ethical practices in all external relationships.
Work-life balance: Promote a flexible work environment that supports employees’ personal needs.
Provide resources and programs that help employees manage work-life balance effectively.

quantitative.area: Proactive safety awareness and continuous improvement

targets.target: Ensure 100% of employees complete mandatory safety training within the first month of employment
Offer a benefits package that includes at least 95% of standard industry benefits, such as health insurance, retirement plans, and paid leave
Achieve a 90% satisfaction rate in annual employee surveys regarding working conditions
Conduct regular biannual surveys to measure employee satisfaction with management’s handling of labor relations and achieve  90% employee satisfaction
Achieve 100% compliance with child and forced labor regulations in all supply chains
Increase representation of underrepresented groups by 15%
Achieve a 100% response rate to human rights inquiries from stakeholders

responsibilities.duty: Conduct an annual review of the Employee Rights and Well-Being Policy to ensure it meets compliance and transparency standards.

policy.monitoring: The Performance reporting will be conducted annually, encompassing a comprehensive review of compliance with labor rights regulations, the impact and reach of employee well-being initiatives, and the effectiveness of training and development programs. It will provide an in-depth analysis of grievance resolution processes, results from human rights impact assessments, and advancements in ethical supply chain practices. Additionally, the report will evaluate employee engagement and satisfaction metrics, alongside the efficacy and reach of compliance training programs.
policy.reviewMechanism: The Employee Rights and Well-Being Policy will undergo an annual review conducted by the HR Manager to ensure it meets compliance and transparency standards. The review will include a thorough analysis of policy implementation, effectiveness, and any emerging issues or trends. Additionally, stakeholder feedback will be incorporated to refine the policy, with final updates.
